scope: external main-building shell, roof and loading dock modules only; existing interior unchanged

interfaces.preserved: CAD main footprint, 72 dock/2 drive-in opening widths/centres, existing internal floor/columns/partitions/equipment
interfaces.module_front: local -Y; origin at wall centerline and dock floor, except ground bollard/roof modules

plan_registration.coordinate_frame: CAD metres; X east, Y north, Z up
plan_registration.policy: Separate X/Y scale, zero XY shear. Main CAD shell/interior unchanged. Regularize rotated building footprints; no bilinear mesh warping.
source_limitations: Diagram is not a survey or an isotropic plan.
NW CAD return is absent from the diagram and is excluded from fitting.
Main CAD doors and shell are authoritative at interior interfaces.

assumptions: Reference-generated images govern appearance; CAD governs physical plan. No survey accuracy claimed for image-derived appearance.
Dock/shell heights retain the existing 13.4m roof / 13.6m facade and -1.2m external-ground interfaces; the references do not establish engineering dimensions.
PV module pitch, fixtures, fabric, lamps and number plates are visual estimates; numbers 01-74 are visualization ordering, not verified operating door IDs.
Solar field outlines and rooftop equipment are measured from the latest all-elements plan; regular 1.12 x 1.95m module pitch, cell counts are not a capacity inventory.
Office glazing is an external facade layer at existing office interfaces; it does not create new CAD door openings.

levels: Near physical modules and recessed mounting channels
solar_lod_policy.threshold_rule: Each nonzero LOD threshold scales by actual bank bounds radius / 70m; equal physical detail distance, not one threshold for unequal banks.
solar_lod_policy.threshold_validation: Final native camera zoom/orbit validation required after import.

intermediate_module_grid.falloff: Periodic smoothstep; linear-light blend; no 6x12 cell lines
